verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for an email SaaS that processes customer message data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies or an opt-out control. EU regional sending covers data residency, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
